one_line: Restorationist Rohilla leader of the Bareilly rebel government during the 1857 uprising.

appearance.age_look: Late 60s, medium height, dignified but battle-worn build.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, wheatish Rohilkhand complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed grey mustache and short beard framing the jaw, deep-set serious eyes with narrow dark brows, default expression calm and authoritative with a hint of steely resolve.
appearance.hair: Short, combed-back grey hair visible at the sides and back, covered by a tall dark maroon Rohilla-style conical turban wrapped smoothly with a subtle gold border and a small dark green cloth tail tucked at the side.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length white cotton angarkha (overlapping front tied at the side) with a faint self-stripe texture, over loose white churidar trousers gathered neatly at the ankles, cinched with a deep forest-green cloth kamarband sash around the waist; over this sits a sleeveless, hip-length dark indigo woolen waistcoat with a simple round neckline and three pairs of small looped buttons, the edges piped in dull gold; his feet are in brown leather Mughal-style mojaris with slightly upturned toes, and he has a plain dark green wool shawl draped from his left shoulder across the back, plus a simple silver ring on his right hand and a narrow leather belt over the sash to anchor his weapon scabbard.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Indo-Afghan talwar sword with a brass hilt and disc pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard hung at his left hip, often drawn and held in his right hand with the blade angled down and forward.

ref_desc: Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla is an elderly Rohilla leader with an oval wheatish face, grey hair under a maroon conical turban, white angarkha and churidar, dark indigo waistcoat, forest-green sash and shawl, brown mojaris, and a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla: an elderly but firm Rohilla leader with an oval wheatish face, deep serious eyes, neat grey mustache and short beard, grey hair at the sides under a tall dark maroon conical turban with a subtle gold border and a small dark green cloth tail. He wears a long knee-length white cotton angarkha with overlapping front, over white churidar trousers snug at the calves, a forest-green cloth kamarband sash around his waist, and a sleeveless hip-length dark indigo wool waistcoat with simple looped buttons and dull gold piping on the edges. A dark green wool shawl is draped from his left shoulder, he has brown leather Mughal-style mojaris with slightly upturned toes, a narrow leather belt over the sash, and a plain silver ring on his right hand. His brass-hilted, slightly curved talwar sword in a dark brown leather scabbard hangs at his left hip; show him in multiple poses including a neutral stance gripping the talwar, so his face, turban, layered garments, footwear, sash, shawl, and colour palette of white, dark indigo, forest green, maroon, brown, and dull gold are all clearly visible from front, side, and back.
